cells.gaps: The master plan has no governance, delivery-plan or reporting row of its own; the plan and finance rows (GMB-006, GMB-007) belong to the Digital ID and Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2028. That strategy is only validated (May 2024, GMB-004, GMB-013, GMB-015) with no accessible text (GMB-014), so it would stand at stage 2. Adoption of the master plan rests on a third-party report that names the government and Sept 2024 but no act; it is dated 2023-2033 in some sources. Stage 4 needs a costed or actioned plan and published reporting.
cells.note: Instrument: National Digital Economy Master Plan 2024-2034, the one adopted national instrument. Adopted, text on the ministry website, in period; no plan or reporting rows, so not stage 4.
